name: Death Counter Popup
description: Shows a text popup of a run counter

enable.name: Enable
enable.description: Whether to show label at all. The run counter is still saved.

gold-new-best.name: Golden New Best
gold-new-best.description: The popup text will be golden if it's a new best (only applicable to runs from 0)

show-for-completed.name: Show for Completed levels
show-for-completed.description: The popup text will be shown even if the level is completed

label-precision.name: Label Precision
label-precision.description: The number of decimal places to display in the label. For example: '13.56-78.11'. Default is 0, min is 0, max is 3.

x-position.name: Pos X
x-position.description: The horizontal position for the label. Lower = left, higher = right. Default is 100, min is 0

y-position.name: Pos Y
y-position.description: The vertical position for the label. Lower = low, higher = high. Default is 270, min is 0

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.description: The rotation of the label. Range is -180 to 180, positive turns clockwise, negative turns counter-clockwise

scale.name: Scale factor
scale.description: The scale factor of the label. Range is 0 to 2

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: The opacity of the label. Range is 0 to 1. To match Megahack status opacity at 1x, use 0.25.

popup-style.name: Popup Style
popup-style.description: How the label is added and shown. 'animated' mimics new best label, 'fade' fades in-place, 'flat' pops in & out instantly

migrate-all.name: Migrate save data
migrate-all.description: For manual migration if the mod failed to migrate all on load

issues.info: Report any issue on the Github repo
